summary: Frontend-only test of TopicPage.jsx `effectiveHighlightId` next-lesson banner fix. All 6 assertions PASSED across 4 scenarios: (1) classmate_k main repro — auto-open + Mark Done on 'Sia And The Silver Coin' correctly moved the orange 'Your Next Lesson' banner to 'Sia and the Silver Coin - Workbook' (content_d65261165daf) with completed card showing green 'Earned 5 XP'; (2) continued flow — completing the workbook moved the banner again to 'Find Rs.1 coins' (content_ddc1142444ec); (3) regression classmate_g3 — homework highlight banner showed 'Your Homework — complete this!' on Candy Shop, and after completion via API + reload of the same ?highlight=...&homework=1 URL the banner disappeared entirely (no re-target to any other item); (4) stale URL reload with classmate_k — after both items completed, reloading the original ?highlight=content_90108cb5e262 correctly (a) did NOT auto-open the viewer for the completed book and (b) landed the banner on the current next-incomplete item 'Find Rs.1 coins' instead of the finished lesson.
critical_code_review_comments: effectiveHighlightId useMemo logic is correct and matches spec — passthrough when unresolved, null for completed homework, next-mandatory-unlocked fallback otherwise. Scroll effect and card ring/banner correctly read effectiveHighlightId, while auto-open effect intentionally uses raw highlightId with is_completed guard (verified — no reopen for completed).
Minor: React key on the memo dependency uses full `topic` object; safe here because topic reference changes on refetch, but could be scoped to `topic?.content_items` for micro-optimization.
seed_data_creation: None.
